notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for a queued timestamped directed interaction whose producing federate resigns before delivery. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the C++ standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies standard target-object routing, timestamped delivery, source-resignation queue retention, the post-resignation retraction boundary, and one directed receive callback with preserved target, payload, tag, producer, timestamp, order, transport, and retraction metadata before the recipient grant. DDM, provider-specific names, registries, headers, and implementation behavior remain outside this contract.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped directed-interaction, object-target, resignation, retraction, and time-advance services with FederateAmbassador directed receive and grant callbacks
